text.en: A home library makes a home richer than gold.

This lesson opens with Abraham Lincoln's saying that the best friend is the one who brings a good book you have not yet read. It notes that what separates humans from animals is not laughter alone but thinking, and that books spur thinking.
The lesson urges every household to keep a small library and build the habit of reading.
Terms: புத்தகசாலை (library), வாசிப்பு (reading), நூல் (book) and சிந்தனை (thought).
